description: 한국전력공사_지역별 전기차 충전소 현황정보 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전력공사. 한국전력공사에서 운영중인 지역 및 연도별 전기차 충전소 현황 정보 입니다. 2016년부터 2025년까지 집계된 연도마다 지역별로 설치되어있는 전기차 충전소 수량에 대한 데이터입니다. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
